access_boundary: This record represents the January 2025 Mistral Small 3 instruct release at Hugging Face commit 9527884be6e5616bdd54de542f9ae13384489724 (last modified 2025-07-28). Its mistral-small-2501 API line retired on November 30, 2025 with migration directed at Mistral Small 4. The Small 3 base weights, the Small 3.1 and Small 3.2 successors, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 24B checkpoint under a declared Apache-2.0 grant with no use restrictions
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated on first-party docs
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on card and docs declarations
The managed API is retired, leaving self-operation as the supported path
